title: The Page Is the Pitch
headline: You're looking at the demo.
subhead: This page took one afternoon. Yours would look like this, say your name, and be live at a link you can put on a menu, a window, or a receipt. Nothing here is a mock-up of a mock-up — the page you are reading is the product.

sections.heading: Why a restaurant needs one
items: Most places send people to an Instagram grid or a PDF menu that loads sideways on a phone. Neither one answers the two questions a person actually has standing on the sidewalk: is this place open, and what does it cost.
A single page fixes that. One link, works on any phone, loads in under a second, and reads the same at midnight as it does at noon.

items.name: Quick Win
items.note: One page like this one, built from what you already have — your photos, your menu, your hours. Live at a link within a couple of days. Yours to keep.

items.name: Launch Kit
items.note: The page, plus short vertical videos cut from your own photos and footage, plus the posting set up so it actually goes out instead of sitting in a folder.

items.name: The part nobody does
items.note: Posting on a schedule after the first week. Most of this work dies because someone has to remember to do it on a Tuesday. That part gets automated, which is the only reason it survives.

items.label: The menu
items.blank: a photo of the printed one works

sections.heading: The one rule
items: Nothing goes on your page that you did not say. No invented reviews, no made-up numbers, no stock photos of somebody else's food. If a fact is missing it shows as a blank until you fill it in — the blanks above are real, and that is deliberate.
That rule costs a little polish up front. It is also why nothing on your page will ever embarrass you in front of a regular.

sections.title: Start with the $99 page
sections.note: Reply and tell me the name of the place. That's the whole first step.

footer_notes: This is a sample page. The restaurant is not real and no business is named on purpose — it exists to show the format, not to imitate anyone.
